fields.headline: How do I center a div in 2026?

details.question: How do I center a div in 2026?

answers.text: Give the parent `display: grid; place-items: center` — two lines, handles both axes, works everywhere.
answers.author: Lena Fischer

answers.text: If it's a single item, `margin: auto` inside a flex or grid parent also centers on both axes.
answers.author: Tomás Rivera
